feeds.title: Her Sides
feeds.description: Seye Oke is an inspirational writer and published author of 'Love's lie' and 'Debbie's Diary'. Her creative works are usually based on biblical principles told in a contemporary African style. Seye lives in Nigeria with her husband and son and enjoys quiet moments with family and friends.

feeds.title: CXXII Apparel Blog
feeds.description: Discover our latest product lines and inspiring biblical verses to keep you going. CXXII is an apparel brand that strives to create unique modern apparel intended to start a conversation. Each design is scripture based in order to plant seeds of truth and share the love of Christ which transforms lives.

feeds.title: IV His Glory Clothing Blog
feeds.description: The IV His Glory Clothing Blog is your new source for edifying articles and content. A Christian Blog dedicated to providing you with thoughtful readings on topics of faith, culture, and community. IV His Glory Clothing designs wearable truth, and provides resources to support Christians on their journey toward a deepened relationship with God.

feeds.title: Modest Style
feeds.description: Keara is a member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints, and her faith is the most important part of her life and influences everything she does. Read the blog to find inspiration for everyday fashion.

feeds.title: The Corinthian's Corner Blog
feeds.description: Looking for Christian inspiration, advice, and good news? Read the Corinthian's Corner blog. Ideal for the modern woman seeking to renew and deepen her faith. Hi there! I'm Corinna, owner, and founder of Corinthian's Corner, I started this blog after having some of my personal experiences in the teaching field that led me to start this blog.

feeds.title: Love in Faith Blog
feeds.description: The Love in Faith blog is the go-to hub for all things faith and encouragement. Dive into a collection of posts that will brighten up your day and also impart insightful and trending fashion ideas. The Love in Faith apparel brings faith to fashion while sharing the love of Jesus. We are a Christian family business and design all products in-house.

feeds.title: Christian Women Living Magazine » Fashion & Beauty
feeds.description: Find the latest Fashion news, recaps, trends, vacation tips and more resources in our Fashion & Beauty Column. Christian Women Living Magazine is an online source of encouragement and fellowship for all women in the body of Christ, presenting views, and current trends in a variety of categories related to Christian Living.

feeds.title: Anothen Blog
